你只说「抓住这里」，它怎么知道每个关节转多少？: You only say where the hand should go — how does the arm know how much each joint turns?
这条机械臂有五个关节，可你拖动的那只「手」只有一个目标点。控制器从没背过任何姿势: This arm has five joints, but the “hand” you drag is one target point. The controller never memorized a pose—every time the target moves, it has to work out on the spot how many degrees the base, shoulder, elbow, and wrist should each turn. Watch the target jump and the arm catch up again and again.
知道每个关节的角度，手在哪儿是完全确定的：从基座出发，一节的向量接一节加到头。现: Once you know every joint angle, the hand’s place is fully determined: start at the base and add link vectors end to end. Right now only the base joint is swinging—watch the hand; the path it traces is just an arc. That is forward kinematics.
给定手的位置反推关节角度，就叫逆运动学。难的地方在于：同一个手位，手臂能摆出无数: Working backward from a hand position to joint angles is inverse kinematics. The hard part: the same hand place admits endless postures—elbow up is one, elbow down another. Watch: the hand is pinned in place, yet the body glides through a family of real solutions. For a robot to work, it must pick one from that infinity at every moment.
FABRIK：拉直一根绳，再一节一节装回去: FABRIK: pull a rope straight, then reattach it link by link
这个 2011 年发表的算法不解方程，只做几何。向后传递：把「手」钉到目标上，从: This 2011 algorithm solves no equations—only geometry. Backward pass: pin the “hand” to the target and fold link by link from tip toward base—the arm is first pulled into a rope; forward pass: pin the base back in place and rebuild link by link. After a few rounds, the joints have negotiated a pose among themselves. The third target is too far—unreachable means unreachable; it can only straighten and point that way.
焊接、喷漆、火星采样，都靠这道题: Welding, spray painting, Mars sampling—all lean on this problem
工厂里机械臂沿焊缝匀速走过时，控制器每毫秒都在解逆运动学；火星车的采样臂把钻头送: On a factory floor, when an arm traces a weld at constant speed, the controller solves inverse kinematics every millisecond; a Mars rover’s sampling arm placing a drill on a rock scientists named solves it too. This arm is now tracking an “IK”-shaped path—not an animation, but a stream of targets solved in real time. Your turn.
